$comment: Project charter — the ONLY binding between Forge and this project. Everything project-specific lives here or in the files it points to (CLAUDE.md constitution, zone canons). Commands, skills, agents and hooks read this at runtime and never hardcode any of it. Generated/refreshed by /forge:bind.

project.name: rag
project.description: Hybrid local/API RAG service: ephemeral Nomad session containers with a configurable external LLM API fallback and a unified RAGResponse.

github.plan_of_record: Epics (type:epic) decomposed into Features and Stories in the GitHub Project; NOW/NEXT/BACKLOG sequence set by /forge:scope

label_vocabulary.$comment: The REAL label set — triage never invents labels outside this.

consult_policy.$comment: When the expensive consults run. Without thresholds every feature convenes the whole panel (mostly opus) — that is how consult verdicts stop being read.

adversarial.$comment: Context-free challengers: contrarian on designs, red-team on diffs. Dispatched with a written brief path and nothing else (adversarial-consult skill).

commit.$comment: Optional 'types' overrides the conventional-commit type enum enforced by guard-commit; omit for the standard set.

constitution.$comment: Where the architecture rules live. The architect and reviewer read these; /constitution amends them with evidence.

models.$comment: AI model routing profiles: 'tiered' (balanced cost-performance) or 'full-brain' (all roles on Claude Opus).

sandbox.$comment: Execution sandboxing: 'smart' (adaptive risk-based isolation), 'strict' (full container), 'native' (macOS seatbelt/Linux bwrap), or 'off'.
